verdict.rationale: The Drive API docs mention an OAuth scope that lets apps 'create, and delete' files (docs-8), implying users/apps can delete data, but there is no documentation on retention policies, scheduled/automatic deletion, trash retention periods, or enterprise data-retention controls (e.g., Vault) for AI-native workflows. Missing for 10: explicit retention policy settings, data export/deletion compliance tooling, and admin-level retention controls beyond basic per-file delete permission.
